name: What is the difference between SEO and AEO and which one should my business prioritize?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between SEO and AEO and which one should my business prioritize?

acceptedAnswer.text: While both SEO and AEO aim to improve online visibility, SEO primarily focuses on organic ranking in traditional web search results through keywords and backlinks. AEO extends this by optimizing for artificial intelligence systems, including conversational AI, voice search, and personalized content delivery, anticipating how AI processes and presents information. Prioritizing depends on your goals: if traditional web search is your sole focus, SEO is primary. However, for future-proofing and broader visibility in an AI-dominated landscape, AEO should be increasingly prioritized alongside foundational SEO.
